name: AI Lead Qualifier + CRM Automation (portfolio demo)

nodes.name: AI Lead Scoring
nodes.notes: Calls the local Python scorer (harness/scorer.py). Deterministic mock today — swap this node for an LLM call to go live. Returns { lead, score, tier, reasons, qualified }.

nodes.name: Create CRM Contact
nodes.notes: Stores the scored lead in the SQLite CRM. Qualified leads come back with status 'pending_approval' plus an approval token.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ lead: $json.lead, score: { score: $json.score, tier: $json.tier, reasons: $json.reasons, qualified: $json.qualified } }) }}

nodes.name: Qualified? (score ≥ 50)
nodes.notes: Routes on the scorer's 'qualified' flag (score ≥ 50). NOTE: after import, confirm the condition reads Boolean — {{ $json.qualified }} is true. (Adjust to your n8n version if the imported condition looks different.)

nodes.name: Send Alert
nodes.notes: Logs to alerts/alerts.log + stdout. Slack delivery lives in harness/alerts.py and is DISABLED by default (set SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL to enable).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ subject: '🔥 Hot lead: ' + $('Create CRM Contact').first().json.lead.name, body: 'Score ' + $('AI Lead Scoring').first().json.score + '/100. Human approval required before outreach.' }) }}

nodes.name: Human Approval Gate
nodes.notes: ⛔ MANDATORY GATE. The workflow pauses here until a human approves or rejects via the generated form. No outreach can run without this step. After import, open this node and confirm the approval form matches your n8n version.

parameters.formDescription: Review the lead below. Nothing is sent without your approval.

nodes.name: Approved?
nodes.notes: Checks the human's decision from the approval form. NOTE: after import, verify the field reference ({{ $json.Decision }}) matches your n8n version's form output.

nodes.name: Draft Outreach (SIMULATED)
nodes.notes: ⚠️ SIMULATION ONLY. Builds the draft message. Nothing here sends email or messages — the next node only writes to the local outreach log.

nodes.name: Log Outreach (simulated)
nodes.notes: Appends the draft to outreach/outreach_log.jsonl with sent=false. This is the entire 'send' — there is no real delivery.

nodes.name: Cold Lead — Nurture Only
nodes.notes: Score below 50: contact is filed in the CRM for nurture. No alert, no approval, no outreach.

nodes.name: Rejected — No Outreach
nodes.notes: Human rejected the outreach. Nothing is drafted or logged.
